description: Use this when someone asks whether Mercury is retrograde now, when the next Mercury retrograde starts or ends, or for the Mercury retrograde dates of a year ("is Mercury in retrograde", "when does Mercury retrograde end", "Mercury retrograde 2027 dates"). Returns the period running now or the next one, with its shadow dates and signs, and the ones after it. Needs no birth details and no place. Say it without fear: it is a stretch of the calendar, not a warning.

year.description: Optional: list every Mercury retrograde of this year.

name: mercury_retrograde
title: Mercury retrograde dates
